requiredArtifacts.description: Synthetic engineering release-readiness pack and runbook
acceptanceCriteria: Phase 8 documents the verified synthetic foundation and explicit production boundary

requiredArtifacts.description: Repository-owner-authored RTK.md instructions referenced by AGENTS.md
acceptanceCriteria: RTK.md exists, contains authoritative instructions and is approved by the Repository Owner

openActions: Repository Owner must provide and approve the missing RTK.md content

requiredArtifacts.description: Independent threat, abuse and application-security review report
acceptanceCriteria: No unresolved high-severity issue remains without signed residual-risk acceptance

requiredExercises.description: Exercise tenant isolation, scope denial, replay and idempotency abuse cases
acceptanceCriteria: Cross-tenant, under-scoped and replay attempts are denied without unauthorized mutation

openActions: Security must perform an independent review and record remediation or risk acceptance

requiredArtifacts.description: Approved PDPA purpose, data inventory, retention, deletion, legal-hold and data-subject procedure
acceptanceCriteria: DPO and Legal approve every collected field, purpose, retention period and deletion exception

requiredExercises.description: Exercise an authorized data export and deletion request against synthetic records
acceptanceCriteria: The exercise preserves required audit records while deleting or exporting all in-scope data

openActions: DPO and Legal must approve policy and review the synthetic deletion/export exercise

requiredArtifacts.description: Approved driver identity, supported-device, location-permission, safety and support policy
acceptanceCriteria: Operations and Safety approve identity, permission withdrawal, incident and support handling

requiredExercises.description: Run pickup, location interruption, permission withdrawal, offline recovery and support journeys on target devices
acceptanceCriteria: Every supported-device journey completes safely or fails closed with an operator-visible recovery path

openActions: Operations, Safety and Mobile Engineering must execute and approve real-device evidence

requiredArtifacts.description: Approved service-principal, data-authority, stock-handoff and customer-tracking contract
acceptanceCriteria: BMS Architecture and domain owners approve every producer, consumer, mutation authority and permission

requiredExercises.description: Exercise order context, handoff, duplicate delivery, missed event, replay and reconciliation paths
acceptanceCriteria: BMS remains authoritative and duplicate, delayed and replayed messages converge without double mutation

openActions: BMS Architecture, Commerce and Inventory owners must certify the contract and E2E results

requiredArtifacts.description: Approved COD custody, fee, earnings, settlement, refund, payout, transfer and tax model
acceptanceCriteria: Finance, Tax and Legal approve money ownership, accounting entries, evidence and dispute handling

requiredExercises.description: Reconcile synthetic happy-path, cancellation, return, shortage and payout-dispute scenarios
acceptanceCriteria: Every scenario balances exactly in satang with an identified source of truth and accountable owner

openActions: Finance, Tax and Legal must decide and approve the disabled financial capabilities

requiredArtifacts.description: Approved tenant/platform access matrix including private evidence and financial separation of duties
acceptanceCriteria: Product and Security approve least privilege, break-glass handling and incompatible duty pairs

requiredExercises.description: Exercise cross-tenant, missing-permission, private-evidence and conflicting-duty denial cases
acceptanceCriteria: Every unauthorized case is denied and audited without leaking private evidence

openActions: Product, Security and BMS Architecture must approve placement, federation and duty separation

requiredArtifacts.description: Approved pilot volume, topology, SLO, alert threshold, on-call and incident-command plan
acceptanceCriteria: SRE and Product approve measurable SLOs, paging thresholds, capacity limits and ownership

requiredExercises.description: Run load, saturation and degraded-dependency tests at the approved pilot volume
acceptanceCriteria: The service meets approved SLOs and emits actionable alerts before unsafe saturation

openActions: SRE and Product must define pilot volume/SLO and approve measured capacity evidence

requiredArtifacts.description: Approved RPO, RTO, offsite backup and recovery ownership record
acceptanceCriteria: SRE and Operations approve objective values, data-loss boundary and recovery authority

requiredExercises.description: Perform a timed restore from an offsite backup using the operator runbook
acceptanceCriteria: Measured recovery meets approved RPO/RTO and reconciliation proves restored consistency

openActions: SRE and Operations must approve objectives and complete a timed offsite restore drill

requiredArtifacts.description: Approved provider inventory, non-production credential custody and network-boundary record
acceptanceCriteria: Security, SRE and the Integration Owner approve credentials, egress, rotation and outage ownership

requiredExercises.description: Exercise timeouts, errors, duplicate callbacks, credential revocation and credential rotation
acceptanceCriteria: Provider failures remain bounded, retries are safe and rotated credentials recover without data corruption

openActions: Authorized owners must supply sandbox credentials and approve outage and rotation drill results
